description: RAID-5/6 stripe syndrome engine: accumulates the P XOR column and the GF(256) weighted Q column four bytes at a time, verifies host-supplied syndromes, emits both parity columns and refuses an over-full stripe
hardware_advantage: Both RAID syndromes are carry-free: P is four byte-lane XOR trees and Q is four GF(256) multiply-accumulates built from xtime shift-xor stages, so a stripe of data columns folds into both parities at one column word per cycle without touching the $mul primitive, which the unsigned GW5A fabric cannot provide for a 256-bit field anyway
provenance: original source authored in this workspace; no third-party RTL imported
qualification: engineering candidate; not certified production or side-channel protection
